verdict.rationale: Summer Engine's own docs say an agent can run the whole publishing flow on Summer Games through its CLI, so it has a first-party command-line path that plausibly covers building and shipping a game. Nothing documents a headless build or export command, multi-platform export targets from the CLI, or CI usage; the documented CLI flags only configure agents and MCP. Missing for 10: explicit CLI build/export commands, a documented headless (no editor) mode, CI pipeline guidance or examples, CLI export to Windows/Mac/Linux/iOS/Android/web, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can build and export the project from the command line, headless, in CI — no human clicking an editor

citations.quote: Your agent runs the whole publishing flow on Summer Games through the MCP or CLI.
Any agent builds, tests and publishes a full multiplayer game
